summary: Iteration 73: Paper Trading Feature - All tests passed. Backend APIs (18/18 tests) and Frontend UI verified. Paper trading with live prices from Alpha Vantage (stocks) and Binance US (crypto) is fully functional.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 73 verified the Paper Trading feature. All backend APIs work correctly: GET /api/paper/portfolio (returns snapshot with cash, equity, positions, P&L), POST /api/paper/trade (executes BUY/SELL with live prices), GET /api/paper/trades (returns history sorted by timestamp desc), POST /api/paper/reset (resets to $100K). Frontend Paper Trading modal accessible from user menu dropdown (nav-paper-trading-btn) and mobile menu (mobile-paper-trading-btn). Modal has Portfolio, Trade, and History tabs with all required UI elements. AI chat correctly injects portfolio context when user asks portfolio-related questions.

backend_apis.GET /api/paper/portfolio: PASS - Returns cash, equity, positions, total_pnl, total_pnl_pct, position_count, starting_cash
backend_apis.POST /api/paper/trade BUY: PASS - Executes paper buy with live price, updates cash and positions
backend_apis.POST /api/paper/trade SELL: PASS - Executes paper sell, validates position exists and qty available
backend_apis.POST /api/paper/trade validation: PASS - Validates insufficient cash, selling more than owned, invalid side/qty
backend_apis.GET /api/paper/trades: PASS - Returns trade history sorted by timestamp desc, supports limit and symbol filter
backend_apis.POST /api/paper/reset: PASS - Resets portfolio to $100K, clears positions and trade history
backend_apis.AI chat portfolio context: PASS - Injects portfolio context when message contains portfolio keywords

frontend_ui.paper_trading_modal: PASS - Opens from user menu dropdown
frontend_ui.portfolio_tab: PASS - Shows equity, cash, P&L summary cards and positions list
frontend_ui.trade_tab: PASS - Has BUY/SELL toggle, symbol input, quantity input, execute button
frontend_ui.history_tab: PASS - Shows trade records with side, symbol, qty, price, total, date
frontend_ui.mobile_menu: PASS - Paper Trade button present and functional
frontend_ui.data_testids: PASS - All required data-testid attributes present

authentication.endpoints_require_auth: PASS - All paper trading endpoints return 401 without auth
authentication.httpOnly_cookies: PASS - Auth via httpOnly cookies working correctly
